practiceProblems.title: If & Else Statements
constraints:
- $1 \leq T \leq 100$
- $1 \leq N \leq 100$
- $1 \leq M \leq N\cdot(N-1)/2$
- $1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq N$
- $u_i \neq v_i$ for each $1 \leq i \leq M$.
- The sum of $N$ over all test cases won't exceed $100$.
practiceProblems.inputFormat:
- The first line of input will contain a single integer $T$, denoting the number of test cases.
- Each test case consists of multiple lines of input.
    - The first line of each test case contains two space-separated integers $N$ and $M$ — the number of vertices and edges of the graph, respectively.
    - The next $M$ lines describe the edges. The $i$-th of these $M$ lines contains two space-separated integers $u_i$ and $v_i$, denoting an edge between $u_i$ and $v_i$.
practiceProblems.outputFormat: For each test case, output on a new line the number of good subgraphs of $G$, modulo $10^9 + 7$.

practiceProblems.title: Else Statement
practiceProblems.description:
As evident from previous example, the  **`else`**  keyword includes anything which isn't included in the previous **`if`** or **`else if`** conditions.

### Task
Some code is written in the editor.
- Two variables **ram** and **karan** are defined.
- Output based on these conditions:
  1. If **ram** is greater than **karan**, output "Ram is heavier than Karan"
  2. If **ram** is less than **karan**, output "Karan is heavier than Ram"
  3. Otherwise, output "Ram & Karan have the same weight!"

Your task is to complete the blanks in the code.

practiceProblems.title: Conditions in if statements
practiceProblems.description:
You are given a score that the player has achieved in a 100 point game.

Print some text based on below conditions:
1. If the score is 100, print "Perfect score"
2. If the score is less than 100, but greater or equal to 80, print "Almost perfect score"
3. If the score is less than 80, print "Nice try"

practiceProblems.title: Problems on Conditional Statements
practiceProblems.description:
Complete the given function **solve()** which should do the following:
- It should take an integer parameter  **`x`**.
- And print the following:
  - `"Order Confirmed"`  only if  **`x`**  <  **`70`** 
  - else Print  `"Order Limit reached"`
  - In both cases, the program must print  `"Thank YOU!"`  on a separate line.
